title: Vice President of Continuous Improvement & Lean
text:
Eaton’s Electrical Sector America’s business is curretly hiring for a VP of Continuous Improvement & Lean. This role can be based at Eaton’s Cleveland or Pittsburgh office. Relocation within hiring country is offered. 50 percent travel is anticipated.
 
 
Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations, Electrical Sector – Americas (ESA), the VP of CI & Lean is the senior executive accountable for the vision, strategy, and results of the Eaton Continuous Improvement System (ECIS) across the $16B ESA business, spanning 60 manufacturing sites and 14 divisions. This role sets the multi-year Lean transformation agenda, builds continuous improvement into the sector's strategic and annual profit plans, and holds the business accountable for measurable improvement in safety, quality, delivery, cost, and growth.
 
 
The VP leads and develops the ESA CI team, defines the sector-wide operating model, standards, and governance the team deploys, and serves as a strategic advisor to the ESA leadership team. Rather than leading deployment within a division, this role directs CI resources to the highest-value opportunities, owns the sector's CI talent pipeline, and shapes a Lean leadership culture at the executive level. The VP also represents ESA in enterprise CI forums, partnering with Corporate CI & Quality to align standards and scale best practices across Eaton.
 
 
**Job Responsibilities**

* Defines the multi-year ESA Lean and continuous improvement vision, strategy, and roadmap, and integrates it into the sector's strategic plan and annual profit plan.
* Owns the ECIS operating model for ESA: sets the standards, maturity expectations, and governance that the CI team deploys across divisions, functions, and sites.
* Leads, coaches, and develops the ESA CI team; sets objectives, allocates CI resources, and holds the team accountable for results.
* Chairs the Divisional CI Council across all ESA divisions and leads sector-level performance reviews, establishing the operating cadence that links CI results to business performance.
* Accountable for the ESA cost-out and productivity commitments delivered through CI; builds the sector project pipeline and validates financial impact.
* Serves as strategic advisor to the SVP of Operations and the ESA leadership team, prioritizing the transformation initiatives with the greatest business value.
* Sponsors large-scale, cross-divisional transformations (e.g., footprint changes, acquisition integrations, and Lean in office and transactional processes).
* Builds the sector CI talent strategy: capability standards, certification pathways (e.g., ASCEND X, PME), succession planning, and rotation of high-potential leaders through CI roles.
* Coaches ESA executives on Lean leadership behaviors and role-models a culture of accountability and continuous improvement from the top.
* Sets sector maturity targets and owns the EBSA and OpA assessment strategy; reviews results with leadership and directs closure of systemic gaps.
* Represents ESA in enterprise CI forums; partners with Corporate CI & Quality to shape Eaton-wide standards and scale proven practices across sectors.
* Manages the ESA CI function budget and champions digital and data analytics tools that accelerate improvement.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications:
 
 

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive experience in Continuous Improvement, Quality, or Operations
* Minimum 5 years leading leaders (managers or directors) at a multi-site, division, or business-unit level
* Proven track record leading Lean transformations that delivered measurable financial results, preferably in a multi-division manufacturing environment
* Professional experience in a global matrixed organization
* Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or MBA preferred

**Position Success Criteria**

* Expert-level command of Lean and Six Sigma; Master Black Belt or Black Belt certification required
* Experience designing, governing, and maturing a business operating system and maturity model at scale
* Strong business and financial acumen: builds cost-out and productivity plans, quantifies impact, and ties CI results to the P&L
* Experience designing CI talent, certification, and capability programs across a large, multi-site organization
* Applies Lean to both manufacturing and office/transactional processes
* Executive presence; a trusted advisor who influences, challenges, and aligns senior executives
* Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams of senior CI leaders
* Strategic thinker who turns vision into multi-year roadmaps and leads change at scale
* Excellent communication at every level, from the shop floor to the executive leadership team

The expected annual salary range for this role is $203000 - $297000 a year. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive program.
 
 
Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.
 
 
All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
 
 
We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant's race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, marital status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by law.
 
 
Eaton believes in second chance employment. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction history will be considered regardless of their arrest or conviction history, consistent with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and other local laws.
 
 
You do not need to disclose your conviction history or participate in a background check until a conditional job offer is made to you. After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Eaton is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report.
 
 
To request a disability-related reasonable accommodation to assist you in your job search, application, or interview process, please call us at 1-800-836-6345 to discuss your specific need. Only accommodation requests will be accepted by this phone number.
